digest.component_or_area: fsck tracker health and doctor repair
propositions: fsck does not detect or classify dirty-tree wedges (tracked artifact deletions, orphaned compaction files, orphaned .tmp-event-* files, stale locks) that cause store wedging
doctor --repair lacks repair actions for dirty-tree classes and cannot heal wedged stores without ad-hoc manual raw git intervention

fsck must detect and classify three distinct dirty-tree artifact classes (restorable tracked deletions, regenerable compaction leftovers, orphaned .tmp-event-* files) as separate findings in both text and JSON output

doctor --repair must heal dirty-tree wedges by restoring tracked deletions and quarantining orphaned regenerables under a scoped write-lock window, backing up HEAD to a timestamped ref, then releasing the lock before invoking reconverge
